theorems.name: General integer-mixing asymptotic Smith slopes
assumptions: Fixed nonsingular integer matrix M, fixed prime p; powers of the same M
theorems.law: a_i(M^n)=n*lambda_i+O_(M,p)(1), including nonsemisimple M; phase-cut slopes agree for a fixed periodic program
theorems.boundary: Not an arbitrary switching or nonlinear cocycle; invariant channels are not native axes

theorems.name: Finite coefficient criterion and all-n bound
assumptions: Same scope, degree d, s=v_p(det M)
theorems.law: Bounded Smith-depth spread iff all slopes equal iff d*v_p(c_j)>=j*s; p-integral characteristic recurrences give a finite all-n bound
theorems.boundary: The constant depends on M,p; no universal family bound or real-metric stability

theorems.name: Exact affine periodicity of balanced local Smith depths
theorems.law: There exist H,K with M^H=p^K U, U p-local unimodular; then a_i(n+H)=a_i(n)+K for every n>=0
theorems.boundary: Search budget exhaustion is not nonexistence; period need not be minimal; no spatial/event return

theorems.name: BRC p-torsion capacity slope curve
theorems.law: (1/n)log_p |G_n[p^floor(tau*n)]| -> sum_i min(tau,lambda_i); exact finite count still uses Smith factors
theorems.boundary: Uniform branch weight is additional; slopes do not recover finite residue positions, arbitrary joint weights or paths
